comparison.objective: Install and retain a rack bracket, versus lower a bent tube into a checking fixture.
comparison.physical_skill: Both involve bimanual handling of an elongated rigid part and simultaneous multi-feature alignment; the PR stops at gravity seating, while the candidate additionally claims tool-less locking.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate needs unspecified mounts engaged and structural self-support; PR requires all four legs seated in slots, released, and still.
comparison.reason: There is substantial alignment overlap, and without bracket geometry it is impossible to show that locking adds a meaningfully different tested ability.
